integrity.claim_scope: first repeated initial length-3^k Cantor factor, including first matching index

limitations: Exact claim covers only lengths 3^k, k>=1, with n=1 separately.
Full text of Nicholson–Rampersad was not accessible; equivalent earlier work remains possible.
Finite program verification checks k=1..8; it does not replace the proof.
title: First repetition law for triadic-length factors of the Cantor word
